fields.PRODUCT NAME: Traditional Brass Lota with Spout (Pooja Achaman Pot)
fields.DESCRIPTION: This Brass Lota with Spout, also known as Achamani Pot or Pooja Lota, is an essential part of Hindu rituals and ceremonies. Crafted from pure brass, it is traditionally used for storing and pouring holy water (Gangajal), milk, or other sacred liquids during poojas, abhishekams, and daily worship. The spout design allows easy pouring, making it convenient for ritual use. Its golden shine and traditional shape add a touch of divinity and authenticity to your prayer space.
